sloka: भक्षयन्वन्यमाहारम् सुतो मे वर्तयिष्यति ।महार्हवस्त्रसम्वीतो भूत्वा चिरसुखोषितः ॥२-१२-१००॥
transliteration: bhakṣayanvanyamāhāram suto me vartayiṣyati ।mahārhavastrasamvīto bhūtvā cirasukhoṣitaḥ ॥2-12-100॥

translations.english: How will he who was habituated to wearing expensive apparels and to (royal) comforts over a long period of time live (sleep) on the ground, putting on saffron robes?
